No exit is performed', with first_frame and n1a failing. Review 4 (phone-fourth-handback.json) again rejected A for 'no visible walkout, only a door and a hanging apron'. Neither later repair batch changed A's s1. The effect on the viewer: the hook asks who will take the order after the server walked out, but no departure is visible, so the opening reads as an unchanged empty room until the phone rings at 2.5 s. Required fix: perform the walkout in A's first 1.5 s on the eye-level stage, so the first frame shows that someone left. For example, a departing figure with an articulated stride and planted feet passing out through the door before it shuts. Or the server's own hand hanging the apron on the hook and withdrawing toward the door. Or an eye-level equivalent of B's footprint trail out of the door. Any figure must meet the brief's limb, scale and ground rules. A door and an apron that only swing do not meet the dominant_action standard on the actual film."
